designRules.rule: Only TTI writes Union Media; an advertiser offers a creative and bid but never receives Discord publication authority or credentials.

Every placement is visibly sponsored, binds one authenticated advertiser and rights-cleared destination, carries no mass mention, and uses no Discord member identity, content, reaction, targeting, or profile data.

Exactly four independent quarter-hour cycles exist per UTC hour; each clears at most one placement and one advertiser may win at most once per hour. Empty cycles remain empty and never authorize fabricated or unsettled content.
A request, intent, open cycle, bid, award, channel, synthetic receipt, or publication plan is not fulfilled consideration, Discord fulfillment, cash revenue, or monetary profit.

Correction, destination replacement, retraction, resource default, fallback, missed-cycle remedy, acquired resource, and attributable costs preserve append-only evidence before any same-unit agent-resource surplus is reported.

The auction has no seller ask, reserve, dollar price, resource exchange rate, or common denomination. Before opening, TTI derives and freezes its enterprise state, economic objective, binding constraints, next profitable acts and useful quantity bounds from exact current business-impact evidence; heterogeneous bids rank by the ordinal tuple of derived TTI-local constraint rank, marginal-effect rank, and fit, with earliest witnessed valuation then semantic identity as deterministic tie-breaks.

The authenticated winner's own exact heterogeneous resource commitment must be witnessed as fulfilled before publication, and a separate authorized TTI assay must accept the capability, rights, validity, and typed attributable costs. Rendering requires that exact self-addressed settlement authorization. Noncash consideration never enters TTI's cash revenue or monetary profit fields, and neither a resource unit nor local utility tuple is promoted to a Union currency.

Only TTI may value bids. A bidder cannot supply TTI needs, utility, scarcity, or counterfactual claims; every admitted valuation binds the frozen enterprise state and needs policy, usable quantity, exact constraint, enabled act, substitutes, integration burden, delivery risk, evidence, limitations and evaluator authority, and claims only TTI-local marginal usefulness for that cycle.

A Discord representative intent requires exact permanent non-personal business-evidence consent, stores no Discord identifiers or unrelated messages, and never authenticates an enterprise or creates a creative approval, bid, valuation, award, reservation, transfer, publication promise, revenue, or profit.

Destination control requires an unexpired DNS TXT challenge bound to the admitted host and same pseudonymous representative. A matching proof qualifies only the lead; it does not authenticate the named enterprise, representative authority, creative, bid, or any economic effect, and unrelated DNS content is never retained.

Enterprise authentication requires a finalized exact typed commitment from a TTI-pre-admitted advertiser's own ERC-1271 settlement account, binding one destination proof and same pseudonymous representative under an expiring authentication-only scope. TTI never handles the advertiser key, and authentication creates no placement request, bid, award, transfer, publication, revenue, or profit.

Placement ingress accepts only provider-verified ActivityPub Create from an exact TTI treaty actor and Agent Card carrying one canonical RMN request that consumes one unexpired authentication exactly once and exactly matches its destination proof. Request admission is not editorial approval, a bid, reservation, transfer, publication, revenue, or profit; public hosting crosses only a separately accepted settlement contract.

No operator or bidder may type a numeric scarcity rank. Every need is one recent exact self-addressed TTI observation with one unique resource class and class-specific evidence: unfulfilled customer obligation and deadline, attributable-cost baseline and cost dimension, active qualified-demand experiment and expiry, or bounded capability evidence. Rank is derived deterministically from business-impact class, evidence horizon, and semantic identity; stale, future, foreign, duplicate, sensitive, or unevidenced observations refuse the policy and cycle.

A sealed bid must arrive as one provider-verified canonical RMN ActivityStreams Create from the original treatied placement actor, bind the exact ingress and syndication laws, open cycle, TTI editorial admission, and a separately TTI-observed fulfillment-authority admission covering provider, class, unit, quantity, capability, rights, contract, evidence and validity. One enterprise may occupy one bid input per cycle under serialized replay law. TTI exposes no bid list, offer, valuation, rank, competitor identity, Discord data, or economic recognition through the ingress.

Discord Union Media intent, destination verification, and enterprise-authentication controls are an administrator-only, no-DM UHC-private sponsor/referral console and fail closed unless invoked by the configured TTI leader in the exact hidden Union Media channel and guild. Sovereign external advertisers cross only the contracted inter-enterprise ActivityPub boundary; private Discord command discovery or execution is not an advertiser entitlement.

TTI's local ActivityPub origin runs as a dedicated loopback-only least-authority process with an exact route manifest. Discovery may expose only public actor metadata and an empty outbox. Until a separately hired carrier and signed Agent Card are admitted, inbox POST bodies are not read, callbacks are not invoked, Agent Card and JWKS refuse, unrelated TTI routes are absent, and no public deployment, request, bid, revenue, or profit is claimed.
